note: Registry of geoid models that GEOLOGIA recognizes for vertical reference claims, with the acceptance gates a grid must pass BEFORE any vertical-transformation claim can exist. As of this version: NO grid file is embedded, NO independent verification values exist, and the vertical transformation is NOT implemented. Answering with a vertical height or a datum shift without a loaded, gate-passing grid must be a refusal, never an inference.

models.name: EGM96
models.full_name: Earth Gravitational Model 1996 (joint NASA GSFC / NIMA)
models.datum_note: the datum ENTITY (EPSG:5171) is deliberately distinguished from the vertical CRS (EPSG:5773) — a model datum and a coordinate reference system are not the same object
models.published_reference: Lemoine, F.G., et al. (1998), The Development of the Joint NASA GSFC and the National Imagery and Mapping Agency (NIMA) Geopotential Model EGM96, NASA/TP-1998-206861
models.tide_system_note: must be recorded from the official model documentation at intake; not claimed here

models.name: EGM2008
models.datum_note: verified from proj.db on 2026-11-22: the EGM2008 geoid datum entity is EPSG:1027 (not 5171, which belongs to EGM96)
models.published_reference: Pavlis, N.K., Holmes, S.A., Kenyon, S.C., Factor, J.K. (2012), The development and evaluation of the Earth Gravitational Model 2008 (EGM2008), Journal of Geodesy, 86(3), 203-234
models.tide_system_note: must be recorded from the official model documentation at intake; not claimed here

acceptance_gates.requirement: SHA-256 of the exact grid file taken at intake, recorded with the fetch source; content-addressed, immutable
the license of the exact file as listed by its distribution channel, checked against the license-purpose matrix before any use beyond indexing
the tide system of the model as documented by its primary authority (e.g. tide-free / mean-tide), recorded verbatim with page reference
grid coordinates documented: coverage extent, node spacing, origin and orientation, units
the interpolation method the implementation will use, declared explicitly — the same grid with a different interpolator is a different claim
the horizontal and vertical CRS pair the transformation serves, per ISO 19111; the registry entries above are the only vertical CRSs this model may claim
acceptance_gates.current_status: declared in registry (5773 for EGM96, 3855 for EGM2008) — binding only after all other gates pass

acceptance_gates.requirement: the region and conditions where the transformation is valid; outside the domain the implementation must refuse, not extrapolate

control values for grid nodes and internal interpolation, derived independently of the transformation library that will use the grid (the same independence doctrine as the EPSG:3857 equations check in ADR-0007)

implementation_status.rule: no code path may return a vertical height or a datum shift derived from these models until every acceptance gate above is recorded and its test passes
implementation_status.agent_rule: any agent answer implying a vertical transformation without a loaded, gate-passing grid is a refusal (honesty doctrine 1: the system does not invent results)

sources_registry: reference_sources.json (same directory) — authority hierarchy and intake policy live there
